answer.origin: NVIDIA Corporation’s Form 8-K filed with the SEC on August 17, 2026; the report states that NVIDIA entered the guaranties on that date.
answer.note: NVIDIA reports that it entered multiple residual value guaranties with SB Energy relating to leases for approximately 4.25 GW of aggregate IT load at the Portsmouth Site. NVIDIA’s aggregate payment obligation under its initial commitment is cumulatively capped at $105 billion. The guaranties generally become effective when the applicable lease commences, and payment is conditional, including on the lessor meeting ready-for-service conditions, expected to begin in 2028. A trigger is OpenAI’s insolvency resulting in a lease default or its failure to pay; NVIDIA would generally cover a shortfall against guaranteed minimum lease value after replacement leasing or sale recoveries. OpenAI has agreed to reimburse and indemnify NVIDIA for amounts actually paid. NVIDIA may provide credit support for approximately another 3.8 GW at its sole discretion; this is optional capacity, not part of the stated initial commitment. The filing also says OpenAI will use the 4.25 GW capacity to deploy NVIDIA’s DSX AI factory platform, subject to limited exceptions. This supports a substantial, conditional contingent-obligation risk for NVIDIA and a planned deployment of its platform at the site. It does not establish that NVIDIA has made payments, that a trigger has occurred, or that the planned deployment produces a particular NVIDIA sale or revenue amount.
limitations: The filing says the guaranty description is qualified by the full agreements, whose form was to be filed with NVIDIA’s Form 10-Q for the quarter ended July 26, 2026; the supplied material does not provide those full terms.
The filing does not state whether any lease has commenced, whether ready-for-service conditions have been met, or whether NVIDIA has paid or accrued any amount under the guaranties.
The filing provides no realized NVIDIA product sales or revenue amount attributable to the planned Portsmouth deployment.
follow_up: Review the referenced Form 10-Q exhibit for the guaranties’ full terms, including the guaranteed-value calculation, payment mechanics, and termination provisions.
Check NVIDIA’s next annual filing for any reported payments or accruals under the guaranties, lease commencements, and satisfaction of ready-for-service conditions.
Check subsequent company disclosures for whether OpenAI’s planned deployment at Portsmouth has begun; do not treat the stated platform plan as realized sales.

proposal.question: What amount, if any, does NVIDIA report as paid or accrued under the Portsmouth residual value guaranties?
proposal.settled_by: NVIDIA’s next annual filing, checking its disclosures of payments or accruals under the guaranties.
proposal.time_scope: From the August 17, 2026 undertaking through NVIDIA’s next annual filing.
proposal.lost_if_folded: Folding this into general deployment or demand monitoring would lose a distinct check on whether the disclosed contingent obligation has resulted in a payment or accrual.
